title.zh: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
title.en: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application

current_state.zh: German regulator BaFin rejected Bitcoin Group SE subsidiary futurum bank AG's MiCA crypto-asset service provider authorization, leaving bitcoin.de trading largely suspended since June while the company pursues an alternative model through regulated partners.
current_state.en: German regulator BaFin rejected Bitcoin Group SE subsidiary futurum bank AG's MiCA crypto-asset service provider authorization, leaving bitcoin.de trading largely suspended since June while the company pursues an alternative model through regulated partners.
